name: clawd-hud-zq
description: clawd-hud-zq: four Claude Code mods, each installed on its own: a HUD side pane with session facts, subagents and animated mascots (the session's mascot walks above the prompt and offers cost-aware auto-tidy, on by default, at a safe point; smooth vector mascots in the desktop app, Ghostty and kitty), a strip above the prompt with thumbnails of the images pasted into it, Tidepool, a look: sea-glass by day and a bioluminescent tidepool by night in the desktop app, with matching terminal themes, and living backgrounds drawn on the GPU that answer your pointer.

plugins.name: mod-hud
plugins.description: A side pane, toggled by /mod-hud: a HUD of the session (header, alerts, then session, context and prompt cache, limits, usage and todos in labelled sections) above every subagent in it (type, model, status, elapsed time, tool calls, current tool, result), with an opt-in status line; the session's own mascot walks the band above the prompt and offers cost-aware auto-tidy (on by default) at a safe point; in the desktop app and in Ghostty or kitty the mascots are smooth vector art.

plugins.name: mod-images
plugins.description: Thumbnails of the images pasted into the prompt, in a strip just above it before you send: real pixels in kitty and Ghostty, coloured half-block cells in other terminals, and /mod-images to see what it sees.

plugins.name: mod-tidepool
plugins.description: Tidepool, a look for Claude Code: in the desktop app, sea-glass by day and a bioluminescent tidepool by night, with slow caustic light drifting behind the conversation; in the terminal, Tidepool Dark and Tidepool Light in /theme.

plugins.name: mod-living
plugins.description: Living backgrounds for the Claude desktop app, drawn on the GPU and answering your pointer: ink in water, aurora, living coral, a lava lamp and a summer meadow. /living switches between them and remembers the choice.
